basic_info.description: Classic two-unit property with timeless appeal perched in the heart of Noe Valley, this 1913 two-unit building offers 1,785 sq. ft. of living space on a 2,850 sq. ft. lot, blending vintage character with endless potential. The main floor features 1 bedroom, 1 bath, a charming parlor room, and access to a spacious front-to-rear basement--perfect for storage, expansion, or creative use. Upstairs, the light-filled unit offers 2 bedrooms and sweeping views of the valley from the rear. A flat backyard,  accessible from both units, provides a serene outdoor retreat ideal for gardening, entertaining, or simply unwinding. Brimming with original period details, this property is a blank canvas ready for your personal vision. A rare opportunity to customize a piece of San Francisco history in one of its most coveted neighborhoods.
